feeds.title: Working On Calm Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Melissa. As an anxious mom in search of calm, I committed to learning to meditate, doing yoga, practicing gratitude, and finding pleasure in everyday moments. I started Working On Calm to explore the tools, techniques, and behaviors that can quiet an anxious mind and to create a positive community and resource for others in search of the same goal.

feeds.title: A Thicket Of Musings Blog
feeds.description: Join me in exploring & discussing all the fascinating things life has to offer. I am a 20-something nurse who grew up in a very small town in Virginia. I struggle with anxiety, but I've found that this blog is a great way to tame the 'anxiety monster.

feeds.title: Threads of Anxiety
feeds.description: I'm Erica. Threads of Anxiety began as a place for me to share my struggles with mental health, specifically anxiety and depression, and to discuss with others how I am coping and finding support. It's now also a place where I strive to share my unique experiences and perspectives on life, and through doing so foster a sense of empathy and compassion among my readers.

feeds.title: Lifestyle of an Anxious Mom
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jessa. I created this space for women like you: moms with anxiety who feel alone, who have questions, + who believe God has more for your life, but you just can't see it right now. Anxiety will do that - it will cloud your vision and hide the blessings right in front of you. I hope to walk with you through these struggles, and share a little bit of what has helped me along the way.

feeds.title: Mummy Conquering Anxiety Blog
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to Mummy Conquering Anxiety. Following my recent struggles with anxiety & depression, I felt compelled to set up a blog. Here you will find a summary of my ramblings. Join me for some honest stories, with a few laughs sprinkled on top!
